zkSubpoenaDesc: E wuru VocalWitness ka njirimara nkeonwe gị ghara iru sava anyị. Ọ bụrụ na ndị ọchịchị ọ bụla jụọ ozi nzuzo gị, azịza anyị dị mfe: Anyị enweghị ihe ọ bụla iji nye.
privacySec1Title: 1. Ihe Niile Dị Mkpa Na-eme n'Igwe Gị
privacySec1Para1: Mgbe ị na-ebugo foto, ndetu olu ma ọ bụ akwụkwọ, ọrụ dị mkpa na-eme n'ime ihe nchọgharị gị tupu ihe ọ bụla apụọ n'igwe gị:
privacySec1Bullet1: A na-ewepụ metadata: Ụdị igwefoto, ebe GPS na nkọwa nzuzo ndị ọzọ na-ewepụ akpaghị aka.
privacySec1Bullet2: A na-emepụta akara dijitalụ: Ihe nchọgharị gị na-emepụta akara pụrụ iche nke faịlụ. Naanị nke a na midia dị ọcha ka ezipụrụ.
privacySec1Bullet3: Ngosipụta siri ike: Ị nwere ike igosipụta na ị bụ ezigbo mmadụ n'ekpughị nkọwa njirimara nzuzo gị.
privacySec2Title: 2. Ihe Anyị Anaghị Anakọta ma ọ bụ Chekwaa
privacySec2Intro: Maka nchekwa kachasị elu, anyị ji ụma ghara idebe:
privacySec2Item1: Adreesị IP gị n'ezie — arịrịọ na-agafe n'ọkwa nchekwa ka ebe gị ghara ijikọ na bipụta gị.
privacySec2Item2: Nọmba ekwentị n'akwụkwọ ndekọ ọha ọ bụla — nnwale ekwentị bụ nwa oge naanị iji gbochie spam ma anaghị echekwa ma ọ bụ gosi ya.
privacySec2Item3: Kaadị njirimara gọọmentị, paspọtụ, data biometric ma ọ bụ ndepụta kọntaktị nkeonwe gị.
privacySec3Title: 3. Ihe Anyị Na-ahazi (Naanị Ihe Dị Mkpa)
privacyAccountInfoDesc: Aha onye ọrụ ị họọrọ, igodo nchekwa na baajị ntụkwasị obi ọ bụla ị nwetara.
privacyContentDesc: Akụkọ gị, midia dị ọcha, akara dijitalụ na akara oge.
privacyVerificationDesc: Ihe akaebe na ị bụ ezigbo mmadụ — n'ekpughị onye ị bụ.
privacyTechnicalDesc: Data teknụzụ amaghị aha eji naanị iji gbochie mwakpo na bots.
privacySec4Title: 4. Dabara na Ikike Mmadụ Ụwa Nile
privacySec4Text: Nhazi anyị na-eso Nkeji 12 na 19 nke Nkwupụta Ụwa nke Ikike Mmadụ: onye ọ bụla nwere ikike nzuzo na nnwere onwe ịkekọrịta ozi n'enweghị nnyonye anya.
privacySec5Title: 5. Anyị Bụ Ikpo Okwu Nọ n'Etiti
privacySec5Text1: VocalWitness bụ naanị onye ọbịa teknụzụ. Anyị anaghị ede, anaghị anabata ma ọ bụ nyochaa ọdịnaya ndị mmadụ na-ebipụta.
privacySec5Text2: Onye ọ bụla nwere ọrụ zuru ezu maka ihe ha họọrọ ibipụta.
privacySec6Title: 6. Ihe A Na-anaghị Anabata & Otu Esi Akọọ
privacySec6Text1: Mmekpa ahụ, ịkekọrịta nkọwa nkeonwe nke onye ọzọ n'enweghị nkwenye, ihe mmetọ mmekọahụ ụmụaka na midia ụgha eji eme ihe ọjọọ bụ ihe a machibidoro iwu kpamkpam.
privacySec6Text2: Ọ bụrụ na ị hụ ọdịnaya na-emebi iwu ndị a, biko kọọ ya site na iji bọtịnụ n'ime ngwa.
privacySec7Title: 7. Ọpụpụ Ngwa Ngwa & Ndekọ Na-adịgide Adịgide
privacySec7Text: Ị nwere ike ihichapụ data ihe nchọgharị mpaghara gị ozugbo site na bọtịnụ Ọpụpụ Ngwa Ngwa. Otú ọ dị, ozugbo e bipụtara akụkọ ma kpọchie ya, ọ na-aghọ ndekọ na-adịgide adịgide.
privacySec8Text: Ikpo okwu VocalWitness, gụnyere ngwanrọ ya, nhazi, aha na akara, bụ ikike ọgụgụ isi pụrụ iche nke VocalWitness. Ị nweghị ike idepụta ma ọ bụ jigharịa ya n'enweghị ikike.
termsIntro: Nnọọ na VocalWitness — ogige ọha ebe ndị mmadụ nwere ike ịkekọrịta akụkọ eziokwu na ihe akaebe nwere nchekwa siri ike. Site n'iji ikpo okwu ahụ, ị kwenyere n'iwu ndị a dị mfe.
termsSection1Text: Site n'ịmepụta akaụntụ, ibipụta ma ọ bụ iji VocalWitness, ị kwenyere n'Usoro ndị a na Amụma Nzuzo anyị. Ọ bụrụ na ị kweghị, biko ejila ikpo okwu ahụ.
termsSection2Title: 2. Ọrụ Anyị – Ogige Ọha Nọ n'Etiti
termsSection2Text: VocalWitness bụ ikpo okwu nọ n'etiti. Anyị na-enye ndị mmadụ ngwa iji bipụta akụkọ ma chebe ihe akaebe. Anyị abụghị onye nkwusa akụkọ, anyị anaghị ekpebi ihe bụ eziokwu, anyị abụghịkwa ụlọ ikpe.
termsSection3Title: 3. Ọkwa Ngosipụta (Otu Ntụkwasị Obi Si Arụ Ọrụ)
termsSection3Intro: Iji mee ka ogige ahụ nọrọ n'enweghị bots na spam, anyị na-eji ọkwa ngosipụta dị mfe:
termsTier1: Okwu Ghe Oghe — Mepee nye onye ọ bụla debanyere aha. Mkparịta ụka ọha dị mfe.
termsTier2: Gburugburu Nwa Obodo — A na-emeghe ya site na nnwale ekwentị nwa oge (eji naanị iji gbochie spam). Anaghị echekwa nọmba ekwentị gị n'ihu ọha.
termsTier3: Ntụkwasị Obi Dị Elu / Akụkọ Egosipụtara — Ọkwa kachasị elu. Midia gị na-enweta akara dijitalụ n'igwe gị, a na-ewepụ nkọwa nzuzo, a na-etinye nchekwa siri ike.
termsSection4Intro: Ị na-achịkwa olu gị. Nke a bụ iwu doro anya:
termsConduct1: Nhọrọ Gị: Ị na-ekpebi ma ị ga-ekwu okwu n'ihu ọha ma ọ bụ nọrọ n'ime nzuzo.
termsConduct2: Bụrụ Eziokwu: Bipụta naanị akụkọ na ihe akaebe ị kwenyere n'eziokwu na ha bụ eziokwu.
termsConduct3: Enweghị Doxxing ma ọ bụ Mmekpa Ahụ: Ekwela kekọrịta nkọwa nzuzo nke ndị ọzọ. Anaghị anabata mmekpa ahụ ezubere iche.
termsConduct4: Enweghị Ọdịnaya Ụgha ma ọ bụ Nke Na-emebi: Ịmepụta deepfakes iji merụọ mmadụ ahụ bụ ihe a machibidoro iwu kpamkpam.
termsSection5Text: Ị na-ejide ikike zuru ezu nke ihe niile ị bipụtara. Site n'ibipụta, ị na-enye VocalWitness ikike ịchekwa na igosi ọdịnaya gị. Ozugbo a kpọchiri ya, ọ na-aghọ akụkụ nke ndekọ na-adịgide adịgide.
termsSection6Text: Anyị na-eji ọrụ ụwa a tụkwasịrị obi maka nchekwa nchekwa na nchekwa pụọ na mwakpo. A na-enye ikpo okwu “dị ka ọ dị”.
termsSection7Text: A na-akwado ikpo okwu site na onyinye afọ ofufo. Onyinye anaghị enye onye ọ bụla ịchịkwa pụrụ iche ma ọ bụ nwe.
termsSection8Text: N'ókè kachasị iwu kwere, VocalWitness anaghị ahụ maka mmebi ahụ na-apụtaghị ìhè sitere n'iji ikpo okwu ma ọ bụ ọdịnaya ndị ọrụ bipụtara.
termsSection9Title: 9. Ọrụ Gị Maka Ihe Ị Bipụtara
termsSection9Text: Ị nwere ọrụ maka ihe ị bipụtara. Ọ bụrụ na mmadụ nwere nsogbu na ọdịnaya, ha kwesịrị iji usoro ịkọ anyị.
termsSection10Text: Ikike niile nke ikpo okwu VocalWitness, gụnyere ngwanrọ ya, nhazi, aha na akara, na-anọgide bụrụ nke VocalWitness naanị.
termsSection10Text2: Ị nweghị ike idepụta, gbanwee ma ọ bụ jiri akụkụ ọ bụla nke ikpo okwu maka azụmahịa n'enweghị ikike edere.
divineNaturalLawDesc: Onye ọ bụla nwere ikike ịkekọrịta ihe ha hụrụ. Nke a bụ nke echedoro n'okpuru Nkeji 19 nke Nkwupụta Ụwa nke Ikike Mmadụ.
subpoenaDefenseTitle: 1. Nchekwa Siri Ike Site na Nhazi
subpoenaDefenseDesc: Anyị enweghị ike inye ozi anyị anaghị anakọta. Njirimara gị na-anọgide echedoro.
subpoenaDefenseBullet1: Enweghị ndekọ njirimara ejikọtara na bipụta ọha gị.
subpoenaDefenseBullet2: A na-ewepụ ebe na nkọwa ngwaọrụ n'ime ihe nchọgharị gị tupu ebugo.
subpoenaDefenseBullet3: Nchekwa teknụzụ siri ike maka ndị na-akọ akụkọ amaghị aha.
opsecProtocolTitle: 2. Ndụmọdụ Nchekwa Ọzọ Maka Ọnọdụ Ihe Ise Dị Elu
networkSafetySubDesc: N'ebe nwere mmachi, jiri Tor ma ọ bụ VPN a tụkwasịrị obi. Zere ibipụta na netwọkụ ejikọtara na njirimara gọọmentị gị.
physicalSafetySubDesc: Jiri koodu nweta siri ike. Ọ bụrụ na ị nwee mmetụta ize ndụ, pịa bọtịnụ uhie Ọpụpụ Ngwa Ngwa — ọ na-ehichapụ data mpaghara ma pụọ na saịtị.
safetyProhibitIntro: A machibidoro ihe ndị a iwu kpamkpam:
safetyProhibit1: Doxxing: Ịkekọrịta nkọwa nzuzo nke mmadụ n'enweghị ikike.
safetyProhibit3: Ihe Akaebe Ụgha ma ọ bụ Agbanwere ezubere imerụ ndị ọzọ ahụ.
safetySection4Text: Nchekwa na-abịa site na akụkọ obodo na ọkwa ngosipụta doro anya:
safetyModTier1: Okwu Ghe Oghe — Mkparịta ụka ghe oghe maka onye ọ bụla.
safetyModTier2: Ntụkwasị Obi Dị Elu — Nchekwa siri ike na aha ọma.
safetyGoalText: Ogige ọha dị nchebe ebe enwere ike ịkekọrịta akụkọ eziokwu ma ebe a na-echekwa ndị mmadụ site na nhazi.
ledgerIntegrityPara1: Ozugbo e bipụtara akụkọ, iwu na-eme ka ọ sie ike nke ukwuu maka onye ọ bụla idezi ma ọ bụ hichapụ nke mbụ.
ledgerIntegrityPoint1: Iwu nchekwa data na-egbochi mmelite na ihichapụ na ndekọ.
ledgerIntegrityPoint2: A na-emepụta akara dijitalụ n'igwe gị.
ledgerIntegrityPoint3: A na-ejikọ ndekọ ọnụ maka nchekwa ọzọ.
ledgerIntegrityClarification: Dị mkpa: Nke a bụ nchekwa siri ike n'ọkwa ngwa, ọ bụghị blockchain ọha zuru ezu. Data na-ebi na nchekwa igwe ojii echekwara.
ledgerIntegrityFuture: Nhọrọ ọdịnihu: Anyị nwere ike ịgbakwunye nkwado ọha ọzọ. Nke a adịbeghị.
